style_contract.recurring_character: One expressive cute round yellow-headed office worker, small simple stick body, sometimes tie, sweat, confused eyes or a tiny crown/hat; consistent recognizable proportions. Use not on every single frame if an object character is the better joke.
style_contract.linework: Thick imperfect black hand-marker outlines, scribbled motion lines, casual uneven borders, hand-drawn asymmetry; not smooth vector-perfect.
style_contract.paper: White or very light blue square graph notebook paper, subtle grid.
style_contract.colors: Flexible pastel pink, pale yellow, sky blue, soft green and lavender accents; do not use a rigid palette per channel.
style_contract.composition: Scene-led comedy. Characters and props interacting or reacting; speech/thought clouds used only when joke needs them. No repetitive three-panel boxes or uniform rectangles.
style_contract.typography: Vietnamese handwritten comic lettering, sparse readable captions. Correct Vietnamese accents; a short setup and a sharp payoff.
style_contract.humor: Office-life irony, escalating urgent tasks, deadline panic, lost stationery, work trip mishaps, practical tips with an unexpected twist. Image must deliver part of the joke, not just decorate copy.
style_contract.photo_exception: Keep effective authentic animal/cat reaction photos photographic; do not redraw them in cartoon style.
style_contract.provenance: Create original drawings and original jokes; do not copy branded characters, creators' meme graphics, actual private chat screenshots or unlicensed photos.

negative_prompt: same card rectangles in every image
repetitive cards with identical layouts across the week
approved_reference_examples: Round-head office worker searching for a missing pen on a tidy desk
Round-head worker relaxing on Saturday while Monday deadline invades thought bubble
Round-head worker casting outfits for Monday on Sunday
Round-head worker reacting to a pile of urgent messages
deprecated_reason: Prior 14-image batch was framed/repetitive and rejected as the brand's primary style.
preferred_creative_workflow: Concept and Vietnamese joke -> consistent roundhead character illustration -> visual human review -> match an existing scheduled slot -> provider verification -> performance tracking
